Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && python3 -c "
import zipfile
with zipfile.ZipFile('dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip', 'r') as z:
    data = z.read('testdata/soccer_cif_20f_q0.ivf')
    print(f'Size: {len(data)}')
    # IVF header is 32 bytes
    print('Header:', data[:32].hex())
    # First frame
    if len(data) > 32:
        # IVF frame header: 12 bytes (4 byte size + 8 byte timestamp)
        frame_size = int.from_bytes(data[32:36], 'little')
        print(f'First frame size: {frame_size}')
        print(f'First frame header: {data[36:36+frame_size][:32].hex()}')
" 2>/dev/null
